scope: Predeclared seven-case development pilot: six financial receipts (five original, one supplied-photo supplement) and one nonfinancial control. No original held-out evaluation receipt selected.
selection: First two original CORD development IDs; first Taiwan Costco; Bristol Costco; historical Tesco; original grouped user Costco as separate development supplement. Frozen pixels match model-comparison inputs. No label file read for selection/inference. Plus the original nonfinancial photo-order control; declared before any real-pilot inference.

vision_process_metrics.timing_scope: Fresh CLI model loading, image encoding and constrained generation; excludes verified download/setup, browser preprocessing and deterministic financial validation
vision_process_metrics.gpu_memory_note: GPU offloading used Vulkan; process working set excludes dedicated GPU memory. One global GPU observation during the first synthetic smoke was 5329MiB used including other applications, not a per-model peak.
vision_process_metrics.comparison_limit: Fresh CLI startup included, GPU shader cache warm after synthetic trials. CPU OCR inference-only and old browser e2e latency scopes differ; no speedup is claimed.

decision: Do not select this exact 4B/quantization/prompt/decoder protocol as an automatic replacement. Some totals improved, but overall product/financial extraction and six-receipt reconciliation did not justify migration. Fix decoder/structured-contract limitations and retest independently before a stronger claim.
limitations: This is a small development pilot, not a full corpus or fresh holdout result. Two format-invalid cases count as application failures, even when some raw fields appear correct.
The native JSON-schema converter reported unsupported \d escapes and silently relaxed those patterns; strict Zod validation correctly rejected invalid tax-rate/negative-adjustment fields.
The CORD negative adjustment also exposes the shared AI contract lacking signed rounding although manual exact-money rounding exists.
The long Costco output included coupon/summary errors; fixing number formatting alone does not establish correct semantics.
Original manual labels are partial except for the supplied source-checked transaction; CORD labels can omit modifiers. Strict complete-financial denominator for the original set remains zero.
The benchmark CLI is experimental/deprecated in this runtime; no public serving, OS sandbox, consumer integration or on-phone deployment was validated.
control_classification_basis: Uses the sealed predeclared nonfinancial-control role. Source visually rechecked as a photo-order form with no purchase prices. Original real_receipt=true and included_in_pilot=false metadata is preserved; broad source-document authenticity is not used as financial eligibility.
